title: DK Bond Tracker UI/UX Layout Redesign — V-model spec suite (prd_items + requirements + test_cases + test_bindings)
derived_from: Locked Discussion #123 (D-01..D-16 all CONFIRMED) + research doc v1.22 + design outline HTML — documentation only, zero new decisions (Stage 2 rule)

requirements.text: Collapsible icon sidebar + single overflow menu + 3-zone pages + bottom tabs ≤5/drawer.

acceptance_criteria.when: the user clicks the sidebar hide toggle
acceptance_criteria.then: the sidebar collapses to icons only and content width increases; expanding restores icons+labels
theme switcher, hide-amounts and notifications appear there exactly once and NOT duplicated in page headers or Settings
it shows at most 5 tabs and the full navigation is reachable via the drawer

requirements.text: Holdings: pinned key columns, scrolling middle, Detail drawer/page with 6 groups.

acceptance_criteria.when: the middle columns overflow the viewport
acceptance_criteria.then: Company/ISIN stays pinned left and Status/Detail pinned right while Rating…Next payout scroll; exactly one row per bond with no meta strip

desktop opens a side drawer (list still visible, Esc closes) and Android opens a full page (back returns to list), both showing Identity, Investment, Returns, Schedule, Classification and Payment history

requirements.text: Payout cells: green=value only, red=unpaid, amber=due soon, no amounts on unpaid.

acceptance_criteria.when: the payout matrix/card renders the cell
acceptance_criteria.then: it is green and contains ONLY the received value with no 'paid' word and no tick
it is red with ONLY 'unpaid' or amber with ONLY 'due soon' and contains NO amount
status colors use the same semantic tokens everywhere

requirements.text: Watchlist: autocomplete, ISIN locks, rating ≤BBB-, presets, move flow, protected delete, collapsed add, visible errors.

acceptance_criteria.when: the user types in the Company field
acceptance_criteria.then: matching suggestions appear and the old-ISIN history strip shows for the selected company
a red popup states the reason with 'View existing'/'Edit ISIN' actions and the field highlights — never a silent reject
options stop at BBB-; below-investment-grade values are not selectable
actions show only Move and Details; Delete exists only inside Details behind a confirm dialog
the bond enters Holdings and the candidate disappears from Watchlist permanently

requirements.text: Goals: locked target, check-ins, consolidated totals, watchlist-only permanent linking, auto-tracking.

acceptance_criteria.given: a new goal with monthly ₹50,000 over 12 months
acceptance_criteria.then: target shows ₹6,00,000 as preview then locks — no edit control exists afterwards

acceptance_criteria.when: a month is tapped in the check-in strip
acceptance_criteria.then: it records invested (green ✓) or not (red ✗) and saved totals update
a consolidated monthly commitment and consolidated saved/invested/returns appear above the per-goal cards

acceptance_criteria.given: the Move-to-Portfolio form with ≥1 active goal
acceptance_criteria.then: a Goal step/dropdown appears; with zero goals it is absent and the move still succeeds

acceptance_criteria.when: its Portfolio Detail Goal tab opens
acceptance_criteria.then: the goal displays read-only with a permanent badge; no set/change/remove control exists anywhere else

requirements.text: Alerts pure feed with filters/batching/empty state; config relocated to Settings.

acceptance_criteria.then: filter chips work, rows group by Today/This week/Older, unread rows are bold with severity bars, and same-type bursts batch into one summary line
the 'All caught up' empty state renders — never a blank list

acceptance_criteria.when: the user wants to change them
acceptance_criteria.then: they are found under Settings > Notifications, not on the Alerts feed

requirements.text: Settings task sections + collapsed SMTP Advanced + single theme home + saved feedback.

acceptance_criteria.then: a section sub-nav shows General/Notifications/Share-Export/Data; only the active section renders — no wall of cards
SMTP fields are hidden behind collapsed 'Advanced — Email (SMTP)' and no Appearance radio exists (theme lives only in the top-bar menu)
an inline '✓ Saved' confirmation appears

requirements.text: Static guide bulb + per-page guidance + semantically tinted accessible tooltips.

acceptance_criteria.then: the light-bulb icon sits in the same position on every page (web and Android)
it explains the page and its blocking/configuration rules (ISIN lock, rating floor, color meanings) in plain language
it carries the semantic tint (red/green/blue/amber) with icon+word, contrast ≥4.5:1, ≤150 chars; on Android tap reveals and tap-outside dismisses

requirements.text: Global search icon → Holdings+Watchlist results → jump to bond.

acceptance_criteria.when: activated and a company/ISIN keyword typed
acceptance_criteria.then: results from Holdings AND Watchlist appear with status chips
the app navigates to that bond's detail (drawer/page or candidate row)

requirements.text: Group-by selector (None/Goal) + tabbed Move and Detail entry.

acceptance_criteria.then: the flat D-02 list renders unchanged
holdings group under goal headers with locked target and mini progress, no-goal bonds under Ungrouped; switching back restores the flat list
it shows tabs [Purchase details][Financial goal] with the goal tab absent when no goals exist

requirements.text: About & Updates separate page: developer, GitHub, updates, license, disclosed referral.

acceptance_criteria.then: About is its own destination (sidebar below Settings / More on Android), not a Settings section

it shows developer details, the GitHub link (github.com/Adi-Mudi/dk-bond-tracker), Check-for-updates + auto toggle, What's-new link, license block, and a Support-us block with explicit referral disclosure

requirements.text: Fluid responsive layout with continuous-resizer acceptance.

acceptance_criteria.when: the viewport is dragged continuously from 320px to 1440px
acceptance_criteria.then: no horizontal page scroll, no clipped text, no overlapping controls; layout uses %/fr/rem/vw not fixed content widths
every interactive target is ≥48dp at all widths

requirements.text: 'Why bonds?' popover + no-recommendation disclaimer on all key surfaces.

acceptance_criteria.then: the popover shows fixed-return purpose, >10-12% expectation check, the flip-side (less daily effort than shares), and the red 'We do NOT recommend any bonds' disclaimer
the disclaimer is present as footer/section text

requirements.text: TDS derivation: net entry, gross=net/0.9, TDS=net/9, consistent across three surfaces.

acceptance_criteria.given: the payment editor with TDS toggle ON and net credit ₹6,330
acceptance_criteria.then: breakdown shows In bank ₹6,330, TDS ₹703, Gross ₹7,033 (net/9 rounding documented)
gross equals net and TDS shows 0

acceptance_criteria.when: Dashboard KPI, Portfolio returns and Payouts are compared
acceptance_criteria.then: net/TDS/gross values are identical on all three (accuracy gate)
text states TDS applies to interest only (never principal) and is a claimable tax credit

requirements.text: Type-first feedback page with screenshot, auto-context, SMTP/GitHub send, offline outbox.

acceptance_criteria.then: only bug fields appear (≤6 required) with screenshot upload showing a preview before send
context (app version, current page, device) is attached automatically without user input
the message sends via configured SMTP with the screenshot attached; GitHub route opens a prefilled issue on Adi-Mudi/dk-bond-tracker
the form saves to a local outbox for retry and the confirmation screen still explains what happens next

requirements.text: Shield Yield logo as app identity on all surfaces.

acceptance_criteria.when: web header, Android launcher, About avatar and favicon are inspected
acceptance_criteria.then: each shows the blue shield + gold coin + green bars mark at appropriate sizes (48/144/512 PNG + SVG + favicon)

requirements.text: Both surfaces upgraded and tested; full suite green; resizer gate pass.

acceptance_criteria.then: the full existing suite plus new UI/TDS/feedback tests pass locally
the APK carries the redesigned templates and launches to the redesigned UI without crash
gate passes with zero overflow or clipping

prd_items.statement: The system SHALL present a collapsible icon sidebar on desktop (expanded=icons+labels, minimized=icons only) with a single overflow menu containing theme, hide-amounts and notifications, a 3-zone page structure (KPI row, detail zone, legend), and bottom tabs (max 5) plus drawer navigation on Android.

The system SHALL render Holdings as one row per bond with Company/ISIN pinned left and Status+Detail pinned right, middle columns horizontally scrollable, and a Detail action opening a side drawer (desktop) or full page (Android) showing six groups: Identity, Investment, Returns, Schedule, Classification, Payment history.

The system SHALL render payout cells as semantic color blocks with no tick marks: green cell shows ONLY the received value (no 'paid' word), red cell shows ONLY 'unpaid', amber cell shows ONLY 'due soon', and NO amount appears on unpaid/due-soon cells.

The system SHALL provide a watchlist with company autocomplete, forced-uppercase ISIN with register-wide uniqueness lock, credit rating restricted to AAA…BBB-, Indian rating-agency and broker presets with persisting custom values, old-ISIN history strip, a holdings-style pinned candidate table, Move-to-Portfolio via purchase form with auto-removal, Delete only inside Details with confirmation, a collapsed default '+ Add' form, and a red popup error for every block (never silent).

The system SHALL compute each goal's target as monthly amount × months at creation and LOCK it, provide monthly invested/not check-ins, show a consolidated monthly total across active goals, link bonds to goals ONLY at the Watchlist move step (permanent, never unlinkable, read-only in Portfolio), and auto-track linked bonds' invested amounts and returns.

The system SHALL present alerts as a pure feed with filter chips (All/Due/Overdue/Maturity), date grouping, batched bursts, unread emphasis with severity bars, tap-to-bond navigation, mark-all-read/clear, a designed empty state, and SHALL move channel/day-wise configuration to Settings > Notifications.

The system SHALL restructure Settings into task-based sections with section navigation (General, Notifications, Share/Export, Data), collapse SMTP configuration behind a collapsed 'Advanced' panel, keep theme control ONLY in the top-bar overflow menu (no duplicate Appearance control), and show inline saved feedback after every change.

The system SHALL provide a static light-bulb guide icon in every topbar opening per-page guidance that explains rules and blocks, and SHALL render field tooltips with semantic tints (red=blocking, green=status, blue=how-to, amber=warning), theme-aware bubbles, contrast ≥4.5:1, ≤150 chars, tap-reveal on touch.
The system SHALL provide a static search icon in every topbar that searches Holdings and Watchlist by company/ISIN/keyword and jumps to the matched bond.

The system SHALL provide a Group-by selector in Portfolio (None=default, Goal=grouped headers with locked target + Ungrouped section, switchable anytime) and SHALL use tabbed detail entry: Move form [Purchase details][Financial goal] and Bond Detail [Overview][Payments][Goal read-only].

The system SHALL provide a separate About & Updates page (own nav item, not inside Settings) with developer details, GitHub repository link, manual check-for-updates plus automatic check toggle, what's-new link, license section, and a clearly disclosed Support-us referral block.

The system SHALL use fluid layouts only — percentage/fr/rem/vw widths with max-width:100%, flex (1-D) and grid minmax (2-D), mobile-first breakpoints 320→1440, clamp() typography, no horizontal page scroll, touch targets ≥48dp — verified by a continuous-resizer test before any screen is accepted.

The system SHALL provide a 'Why bonds?' info popover covering fixed-return purpose, the >10-12% expectation check (equity territory), the flip side (bonds need less daily effort), and a prominent disclaimer that the app does NOT recommend any bonds; the disclaimer SHALL also appear in About and as a Dashboard/Portfolio footer line.

The system SHALL treat user-entered payment amounts as bank credit (net) and, when the TDS toggle is on, derive gross = net/0.9 and TDS = net/9 (10% of gross interest only, never principal, per s.193/393), displaying the three-way breakdown in the payment editor, Portfolio returns, and the Dashboard KPI with identical values everywhere.

The system SHALL provide a type-first feedback page (Bug/Feature/Question) with ≤6 required fields per type, optional screenshot with preview, auto-attached context (version, page, device), send via configured SMTP email or prefilled GitHub issue, local outbox fallback when offline, and a confirmation screen.
The system SHALL use the Shield Yield logo (concept B: blue shield + gold coin + green bars) as the application identity across web header, Android launcher icon, About avatar and favicon.

The system SHALL deliver the redesign on BOTH surfaces from the one Flask template codebase — web browser AND Android APK — with the full pytest suite green and the continuous-resizer gate passing on every redesigned screen.

test_cases.title: Sidebar collapse + single overflow menu + tab cap (UI-01)
test_cases.steps: 1. Open web dashboard. 2. Click sidebar hide. 3. Inspect overflow menu contents. 4. Count Android bottom tabs.
test_cases.expected: Sidebar icons-only when hidden; theme/hide-amounts/notifications only in overflow; ≤5 tabs

test_cases.title: Holdings pinned columns + detail drawer/page (UI-02)
test_cases.steps: 1. Seed 5 bonds. 2. Narrow viewport to force scroll. 3. Verify sticky ends. 4. Click Detail on desktop; open Detail on Android.
test_cases.expected: Ends pinned, one row per bond, drawer on desktop with 6 groups, full page on Android

test_cases.title: Payout cell color/content rules (UI-03)
test_cases.steps: 1. Seed paid/unpaid/due-soon months. 2. Assert cell classes and text for each state.
test_cases.expected: Green=value only; red='unpaid' only; amber='due soon' only; no amounts on unpaid; no ticks anywhere

test_cases.title: Watchlist locks, errors, move flow (UI-04)
test_cases.steps: 1. Type company → suggestions + history strip. 2. Submit duplicate ISIN → popup. 3. Check rating options ceiling. 4. Move candidate → gone from list; Delete only in Details with confirm.
test_cases.expected: All locks and visible-error behaviors match UI-04 acceptance

test_cases.title: Goals lock/check-ins/linking/auto-track (UI-05)
test_cases.steps: 1. Create goal → verify locked target. 2. Check-in months. 3. Move bond with/without goals. 4. Verify read-only Goal tab + consolidated header.
test_cases.expected: Target immutable; linking only at move; auto totals update

test_cases.title: Alerts feed filters/batching/empty + config location (UI-06)
test_cases.steps: 1. Seed alert types. 2. Exercise filters, batching, mark-all. 3. Clear all → empty state. 4. Assert channels/rules live in Settings.

test_cases.title: Settings sections + collapsed SMTP + single theme home + saved (UI-07)
test_cases.steps: 1. Open Settings. 2. Verify sub-nav + section switch. 3. Verify Advanced collapsed and no Appearance radio. 4. Change a pref → ✓ Saved.

test_cases.title: Guide bulb + tinted tooltips a11y (UI-08)
test_cases.steps: 1. Locate bulb on every page. 2. Open guide → rules text. 3. Inspect tooltip tint/contrast/length; tap behavior on Android.

test_cases.title: Search across Holdings+Watchlist (UI-09)
test_cases.steps: 1. Seed bonds in both registers. 2. Search keyword. 3. Click result.
test_cases.expected: Combined results with chips; navigation to bond

test_cases.title: Group-by toggle + tabbed entry (UI-10)
test_cases.steps: 1. Default None. 2. Switch to Goal → headers/Ungrouped. 3. Switch back. 4. Open Move form tabs; Detail tabs.

test_cases.title: About page contents + referral disclosure (UI-11)
test_cases.steps: 1. Open About via nav. 2. Assert developer/GitHub/update/license/support blocks + disclosure text.
test_cases.expected: UI-11 acceptance met; About not inside Settings

test_cases.title: Continuous-resizer 320→1440 gate (UI-12)
test_cases.steps: 1. For each redesigned route, drag viewport 320→1440 capturing widths. 2. Assert zero horizontal scroll, no overlap; measure touch targets ≥48dp at 375.

test_cases.title: Why-bonds popover + disclaimer surfaces (UI-13)
test_cases.steps: 1. Open info popover. 2. Assert four content blocks. 3. Assert disclaimer on About + Dashboard/Portfolio footer.

test_cases.title: TDS math + cross-surface accuracy gate (UI-14)
test_cases.steps: 1. Save net 6330 with toggle on → assert 6330/703/7033. 2. Toggle off → gross=net. 3. Compare Dashboard vs Portfolio vs Payouts totals.
test_cases.expected: Derived values identical everywhere; interest-only note present

test_cases.title: Feedback type-first flow + send routes (UI-15)
test_cases.steps: 1. Select each type → assert field sets. 2. Attach screenshot → preview. 3. SMTP send (test sink) + GitHub prefilled URL. 4. Offline submit → outbox.

test_cases.title: Logo B assets present (UI-16)
test_cases.steps: 1. Assert SVG/PNG(48/144/512)/favicon files exist and render in header, launcher, About, favicon.

test_cases.title: Dual-surface delivery gate (UI-17)
test_cases.steps: 1. Full pytest suite. 2. Android APK build + Waydroid/device smoke to redesigned UI. 3. TC-UI-12 per screen.
test_cases.expected: Suite green; APK launches redesigned UI; resizer gates pass

test_cases.title: Regression: existing suite stays green (UI-17)
test_cases.steps: 1. Run full existing tests/ suite unchanged.
